scenarios.title: Change a documentation project
scenarios.outcome: Content, navigation, settings or components are changed; the site is built and checked locally without publication.

scenarios.title: Upgrade the Docara engine
scenarios.outcome: The package and engine are updated by a transactional upgrade (or an explicit adoption of a pre-manifest project), the full build and verify-static pass, and the rollback path is confirmed.

scenarios.title: Change and publish to static hosting
scenarios.outcome: The verified build bytes are published atomically by the site operator with a backup and a rollback; build, verification and publication are reported as separate states.

operations.title: Find the project and fix the outcome
operations.summary: Find the root with docara.json, check git status and preserve others' work, read docara.json, locale roots, the nearest section.json, the page sidecar and the Framework lock; reduce the request to one main outcome and the smallest complete change.

operations.title: Read the installed package's contract
operations.summary: Find the project's executable (vendor/bin/docara or an exact package checkout), run capabilities --json or the documented legacy route, and compare commands, schemas and types with the exact installed version.

operations.title: Change the project's own sources
operations.summary: Check IDs and fields against the schema, registry or inspect and change only project sources: Markdown, front matter, docara.json, section.json, sidecar, lang.json, redirects.json, assets, examples, smart/ or design/; never edit build_*, .docara or the packaged engine.

operations.title: Upgrade the package and engine transactionally
operations.summary: Run upgrade --check, --dry-run and --apply by the exact plan; for a pre-manifest project first adopt explicitly with update --dry-run --adopt, --apply, --verify. Never use init --update.

operations.title: Build the site
operations.summary: Choose the build: a single page only for an existing route after an accepted full build with no change to shared state; otherwise a full production build.

operations.title: Verify the static output
operations.summary: Run verify-static on the exact build folder; do not weaken path traversal, link, hash or ownership checks to make a build pass.

operations.title: Check the verified bytes over HTTP
operations.summary: For visible changes serve the verified build with serve --no-build and check the affected routes, navigation, search, themes, responsiveness and keyboard use; otherwise record why the check is not needed.

operations.title: Publish the static site
operations.summary: Build with the right base_url, copy only verified bytes to versioned staging, compare digests, check routes, assets, search and themes, then switch traffic atomically through the site operator with a backup, a rollback and explicit live authorization.

operations.title: Report the result
operations.summary: Return the project root and package revision, the source owners changed and the scope, commands run, the build path and verify-static result, QA coverage, and separately the release and publication states with the next safe step.
